creative_direction: Original playful progression animation inspired by the responsiveness and reward clarity of language-learning apps. Do not copy Duolingo's owl, sounds, exact streak flame, illustrations, copy or proprietary timing/visual assets.
principles: celebrate completed real-world actions, not addictive app time
animations are brief, purposeful and interruptible
respect iOS Reduce Motion and Android animator settings
sound off by default; haptics optional

patterns.motion: slow breathing/float, occasional blink or glance
mascot jumps, confetti dots burst, XP counter rolls up
card compresses 0.98, checkmark draws, XP chip flies to level meter

patterns.trigger: verified qualifying activity adds a day
patterns.motion: streak symbol pulses once; calendar cell fills
full-screen milestone sheet, original mascot reacts, progress path node unlocks
button morphs to Request sent / Joined with spring scale and progress shimmer
one subtle ring pulse on plan clusters, no flashing user markers
path draws to next node; node blooms with a color fill
sheet rises 18dp with fade; background dims

qualifying_actions: activity completion confirmed by host and at least one attendee or verified group check-in
hosted plan completed without cancellation abuse
quest_rules.streak_policy: Weekly consistency goal by default (e.g. 2 verified activities/week), optional daily streak for users who opt in; include rest days and one recover/freeze mechanic; never punish inactivity with lost social access.
anti_gaming: deduplicate participants and repeated same-plan actions
mutual confirmation or proximity check-in with manual appeal

engineering.preferred_stack: React Native Reanimated for UI transitions/gestures; Rive for original mascot and stateful character animations; native haptics API; optional Lottie for lightweight one-shot effects
engineering.performance: target 60fps on mainstream devices; lazy-load large animation assets; provide static fallback
